facts.text: The interpretation into Greek at trial was poor and did not cover all words; the applicant was interrupted when trying to speak and was not allowed to explain about a penknife found in her handbag or her injuries.

The applicant alleged that she had taken it with her to peel an apple and that the blade was not even two inches long. She tried to explain the position to the judge but was not allowed to. She showed her bandaged arm in order to complain about the beating she had suffered, but an officer replied that she could have injured herself by falling down.

facts.text: In his report of 7 December 1989, the UN Secretary General stated that on 19 July about 1,000 Greek Cypriot demonstrators forced their way into the UN buffer zone, broke through barriers, and were apprehended by Turkish-Cypriot police and security forces.

anchor.surface_text: 21.  In his report of 7 December 1989 on the UN operations in Cyprus, the UN Secretary General stated, inter alia: “A serious situation, however, arose in July as a result of a demonstration by Greek Cypriots in Nicosia. They then broke through the line formed by UNFICYP soldiers and entered a former school complex where UNFICYP reinforcements regrouped to prevent them from proceeding further.
